text:
Ashwin: starting intake for nightingale-7b-chat (hf:open/nightingale-7b-chat-v1). want both hosted baseline and dedicated-ready profile. kicking off perf+quality plan now.
Marie (ml-eng): noted. priority? customer wants a fast on-prem fallback for chatgen.
Ashwin: P1 dedicated (low-latency fallback), P2 hosted. scope: accuracy vs current prod-chat model, latency/throughput grid, int8/int4 viability, single-gpu memory footprint (T4/A10G).
Eva: quick checklist sketch:
- unit evals: 500 synth + 2k sampled real chat turns
- prompt suites: conversational, summarization, instruction-following
- ctx-length sweep up to 12k for chat history
- perf: seq=[128,256,512,1024], bs=[1,2,4,8]
- quant experiments: int8 calibration, int4 PTQ (per-channel) + small QAT trial
Dan: propose gates to start discussion:
- p50 <45ms @bs=1 seq=256 on A10G
- p95 <160ms
- throughput >= 140 tps @bs=8 seq=256
- quality regression <=1.2% ourscore delta vs prod
Marie (ml-eng): add max single-gpu vram <38GB for single-device serving. If quant reduces mem>35% it's worth prioritizing.
benchbot: launching fast smoke: ./bench/run --model nightingale-7b-chat --device a10g --bs 1,4,8 --seq 256,512 --quant fp16
benchbot: smoke snapshot: bs=1 seq=256 p50=43ms p95=115ms; bs=8 seq=256 tps=143; mem_peak=21GB
Ashwin: baseline looks promising. plan: run int8 calibrated and int4-ptq quick tests, and a 1k-sample quality check on the convo suite.
Eva: scheduling int8 (calib 500 samples) on A10G and int4-ptq (per-channel symmetric, calib 1k) on T4. also will run a tiny QAT loop (2 epochs) to sanity-check code-gen behaviour.
Ops-Bot: FYI staging dedicated pool free Wed 05/12 02:00-06:00 UTC. reply YES to reserve.
Dan: reserving Wed 05/12 slot. will prepare canary plan afterward.
benchbot: int8 quick results: bs=1 seq=256 p50=36ms p95=95ms; bs=8 seq=256 tps=180; mem=17GB
benchbot: int4-ptq quick results: bs=1 seq=256 p50=33ms p95=88ms; bs=8 seq=256 tps=200; mem=11.5GB
Eva: quick quality delta (convo suite, 1000 samples): int8 delta +0.3% vs prod, int4-ptq delta +1.6% with occasional hallucination in follow-up clarifications. QAT small-run reduced those hallucinations a bit.
Marie (ml-eng): int4 delta >1.2% so that's a red flag for hosted immediate rollout; for dedicated fallback maybe ok if we limit to read-only/chat-lite workloads. need more calibration for int4.
Ashwin: suggestion: if int4 saves >40% mem and int8 meets quality gates, then dedicated can use int8 for now and we continue int4 improvement in parallel.
Dan: drafting canary config: route dedicated->nightingale-7b-chat:v1; rollout 5% for 30m -> 25% for 1h -> 100% if stable. monitors: p95 latency, error rate, ourscore. auto rollback thresholds: p95 up >30% or ourscore regression >1.2%.
Security: will run PII detection on the 3 prompt suites; request sent, ETA Tue AM.
Eva: note: long-ctx (8k-12k) on fp16 caused spikes in kv-cache memory on T4; trying kv-shard + attention-split heuristics now. if that doesn't work, we may require A10G for >8k contexts.
Ashwin: mark the long-ctx memory spike as a potential blocker for hosted long-history mode. include in the risk section.
benchbot: scheduling full grid sweep on reserved dedi slot Wed 05/12: bs=[1,2,4,8], seq=[128,256,512,1024], quant=[fp16,int8,int4], plus ctx-sweep up to 12k on A10G.
Marie (ml-eng): action items:
- Ashwin: finalize gate thresholds and upload gate doc (EOD Tue)
- Eva: run full quant experiments + 3 eval suites + long-ctx runs (results Wed AM)
- Dan: reserve dedi pool + push canary config (Wed AM)
- Security: PII suite review (Tue AM)
Ashwin: will post perf matrix CSV and a short decision note after the full sweep. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 
benchbot: logs will land at https://internal.redwood/run/2360004321/nightingale-onboard-logs
